component.name: Platform Power
component.summary: Thermal profile, battery charging and BIOS power settings

description.p: Platform Power manages the same category of settings as Dell Command | Power Manager on Windows, using standard Linux kernel interfaces: ACPI thermal/performance profile, battery charge-threshold management, and, on machines whose firmware exposes it, BIOS-level extras such as Peak Shift, scheduled battery charging and USB-C PowerShare.
It is an independent, original implementation and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Dell Technologies. Available settings depend on your machine's BIOS and kernel version.
Initial release: thermal profile, battery charge thresholds, and dynamically-discovered BIOS power attributes.
